text:
Type: storage bench with large drawer
Use: seating plus storage for toys or shoes; children's room, playroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: smooth painted board, matte black drawer front, cut-out handles
Colors: black front, white frame
Shape: low boxy bench with a flat white top, one deep full-width black drawer, two cut-out finger pulls along the top edge, plinth base, compact and graphic
Feel: graphic, tidy, bold, practical
Goes with: white walls, light wood, black and white textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms or modern entryways

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
